research_findings.area: Hero Slider UX & Accessibility (HP Poly / Cisco / WCAG 2.2 SC 2.2.2)
research_findings.finding: Current Home.tsx hero uses an automatic 10-second timer (L216) with anonymous pagination bars (L749-763), no explicit Pause/Play toggle for keyboard/screen-reader users, and hides prev/next arrows until hover (opacity-0 group-hover/slider:opacity-100). B2B Pro-AV leaders replace blind dots with named solution tabs (e.g., 01 Boardroom AV, 02 Corporate Events, 03 Delegate Systems), a 44x44px Pause/Play button, and pause-on-focus.

Both hero buttons currently compete with similar high-emphasis uppercase styling, while mobile/desktop slide context does not dynamically adapt secondary trust proof (e.g., 15-Min SLA, Official Warranty, PPRA/FBR GST). High-converting B2B hardware heroes pair 1 primary solid CTA with 1 calm ghost secondary CTA + a crisp 1-line SLA/trust anchor.

While the dark hero eyebrow now passes AA at 6.56:1 (#38BDF8 on #1A2B4C), 7+ sections below the fold still render #00B4D8 text/prices directly on #FFFFFF/#F8F9FA (2.46:1 / 2.34:1 FAIL): Dual Pillars kicker (L788), service CTA links (L827, L857), Featured Hardware kicker (L874), Bento PKR prices (L1040-1100), and AEO/FAQ kickers & table column header (L1210, L1279, L1315).

research_findings.area: Pill Clutter, Card Radius Inconsistency & Non-Tabular PKR Prices
research_findings.finding: Static Brand/SKU strings sit in boxed border-gray-200 chips; Dual Pillars uses detached rounded-full all-caps capsules; cards alternate between rounded-3xl, rounded-[2.5rem], and rounded-[3rem]; PKR numbers lack tabular-nums alignment.
